name: openspec_new_change
description: Scaffold a new OpenSpec change in the target repo (openspec new change --json); seeds the tasks-artifact file-disjoint independence rule in openspec/config.yaml if missing.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the target git repo to scaffold the OpenSpec change into (openspec/ root is self-bootstrapped if missing).

name.description: Arbitrary identifier (e.g. a git branch name) that is slugified into a valid OpenSpec change id (lowercase kebab-case).

description.description: Optional human-readable change description passed to `openspec new change --description`; omitted entirely when blank.

changeName.description: The scaffolded OpenSpec change's id, as returned by `openspec new change --json`.

changeDir.description: Absolute path to the new change's directory.

schema.description: Name of the OpenSpec schema the change was created under (explicit --schema or the root's default).

tasksRuleSeeded.description: True if the tasks-artifact file-disjoint independence rule was newly added to openspec/config.yaml; false if it was already present or the config file is missing.
